description: Source code implementing memory BIO operations for OpenSSL's BoringSSL library, including functions for creating, freeing, reading, writing, and controlling memory BIOs.

methods.name: BIO_new_mem_buf
methods.description: Creates a new read-only memory BIO with the provided buffer.

methods.name: mem_free
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a memory BIO.

methods.name: mem_read
methods.description: Reads data from a memory BIO.

methods.name: mem_write
methods.description: Writes data to a memory BIO.

methods.name: mem_gets
methods.description: Reads a line from a memory BIO.

methods.name: mem_ctrl
methods.description: Performs control operations on a memory BIO.

methods.name: BIO_s_mem
methods.description: Returns the method structure for memory BIOs.

methods.name: BIO_mem_contents
methods.description: Retrieves the contents and length of the memory BIO.

methods.name: BIO_get_mem_data
methods.description: Gets the data pointer and length of the memory BIO.

methods.name: BIO_get_mem_ptr
methods.description: Gets the BUF_MEM structure of the memory BIO.

methods.name: BIO_set_mem_buf
methods.description: Sets the BUF_MEM buffer for the memory BIO.

methods.name: BIO_set_mem_eof_return
methods.description: Sets the return value when EOF is reached.
